meta.what: 500 random OSV-5M test photos with the true location and the DIG-XL (GeoCLIP latent) model's guesses
meta.model: DIG-XL, GeoCLIP latent, trained on OSV-5M train, step 750000 (checkpoint dig_osv5m_geoclip.pt, decoder lae_geoclip.pt + 5 refinement steps)
meta.model_answer: photos[].model: of the 100 unguided guesses for the photo, the one with the highest average GeoScore when each of the 100 is treated as the true location (minimum Bayes risk for GeoScore)
meta.model_guided: photos[].model_guided: one guess at guidance scale 3 (the paper's single-guess protocol)
meta.samples: photos[].samples: the 100 unguided guesses, [lat, lon] in degrees, rounded to 0.001
meta.geoscore: 5000 * exp(-km / 1492.7), km = great-circle distance with Earth radius 6371 km (OSV-5M's GeoScore)
meta.license: Images: OSV-5M test set (street-level photos from Mapillary contributors), CC BY-SA 4.0. Credit OSV-5M / Mapillary; the images stay under CC BY-SA 4.0.
